map.s 位（setuid）怎么表示？: How is the s bit (setuid) represented?
map.特殊位加在最前，如 4755 表示 setuid+755。: The special bit comes first, so 4755 means setuid plus 755.
map.umask 和 chmod 有什么关系？: How does umask relate to chmod?
map.umask 决定新建文件的默认权限：实际权限 = 默认权限 & ~umask。文: umask determines the default permissions of newly created files: actual permissions = default permissions & ~umask. Files default to 666 and directories to 777, so with umask 022 a new file becomes 644 and a new directory 755. Changing umask affects only files created afterward and does not change the permissions of existing files.
